_A_ACCORDION_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: AAccordion shows sections that can be opened and closed, e.g. questions and answers. Every header is a button in a heading (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern): it works with Tab, Enter and Space, and a screen reader announces whether the section is open.
_A_ACCORDION_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: The items are in data with label and content. Only one item is open at a time. The header button is in an h3, the level is set with header-tag.
_A_ACCORDION_ALWAYS_OPEN_DESCRIPTION_: With always-open several items can be open at the same time. with-gap separates the items.
_A_ACCORDION_ONE_ITEM_ALWAYS_OPEN_DESCRI: With one-item-always-open one item always stays open, here the first one from ids-for-open-default. The open item can not be closed: its button has aria-disabled="true" but stays focusable, so a screen reader still reads it.
_A_ACCORDION_V_MODEL_DESCRIPTION_: v-model contains the ids of the open items. The id of an item is its index, nested ids are joined with _ (e.g. 0_1). Here the buttons open and close all items.
_A_ACCORDION_CHILDREN_DESCRIPTION_: Nested items are in children. Their headings get the next level (h4). With key-id the ids come from the items (e.g. shipping_abroad). indexes-for-open opens items by their indexes, nested indexes are joined with a dot (0.1).
_A_ACCORDION_SLOTS_DESCRIPTION_: An item with slotButton and slotContent gets its own slots for the header and the content. With isRenderBodyByFirstOpen the content is rendered only when the item is opened for the first time.
_A_ACCORDION_DISABLED_DESCRIPTION_: disabled: true in an item disables its button: it can not be opened and is skipped by Tab. The prop disabled disables all items.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_ALWAYS_OPEN_DESCRIPTI: Several items can be open at the same time. Without it, opening an item closes the others except its parents.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_CLASS_BODY_DESCRIPTIO: Class of the content of every item.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_CLASS_BUTTON_DESCRIPT: Class of the header button of every item.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_CLASS_HEADER_DESCRIPT: Class of the heading around the header button of every item.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_DATA_DESCRIPTION_: Items of the accordion with a label, a content and optional nested items. Other keys of an item: disabled, readonly, isCaret, extra, slotButton, slotContent, id (id of the header button).
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_DISABLED_DESCRIPTION_: Disables all items. A single item is disabled with disabled: true in the item.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_HEADER_TAG_DESCRIPTIO: Heading around the header button (WAI-ARIA accordion). h3 by default, nested items get the next level (at most h6). Set the level that fits the page, e.g. h2. A tag that is not a heading (e.g. div) is used as it is.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_ID_DESCRIPTION_: Prefix of the ids of the header buttons and the panels. Every accordion gets its own id by default.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_IDS_FOR_OPEN_DEFAULT_: Ids of the items that are open at the start. The id of an item is its index or the value of key-id, nested ids are joined with _ (e.g. 0_1). To change the open items later use v-model.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_INDEXES_FOR_OPEN_DESC: Indexes of the items that are open. Nested indexes are joined with a dot (e.g. 0.1). Every change of the array opens these items.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_IS_CARET_DESCRIPTION_: Shows the open/close icon on the right of the header. For a single item: isCaret.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_CHILDREN_DESCRIPT: Key of the nested items in an item.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_CLASS_BODY_DESCRI: Key of an item with an own class of its content.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_CLASS_BUTTON_DESC: Key of an item with an own class of its header button.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_CLASS_HEADER_DESC: Key of an item with an own class of its heading.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_CONTENT_DESCRIPTI: Key of the content of an item. Accepts a translation key and HTML, the HTML is sanitized.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_ID_DESCRIPTION_: Key of an item with its id. Without it the index of the item is used.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_IS_RENDER_DESCRIP: Key of an item: false hides the item.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_IS_RENDER_BODY_BY: Key of an item: true renders the content only when the item is opened for the first time, e.g. for heavy content.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_DESCRIPTION: Key of the label of an item. Accepts a translation key and HTML, the HTML is sanitized.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_DESCRIPTI: Ids of the open items (v-model), e.g. ['0', '1_0']. Every opening and closing updates it.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_ONE_ITEM_ALWAYS_OPEN_: One item always stays open. Its button can not close it and has aria-disabled="true". Has no effect with always-open.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_PREVENT_DESCRIPTION_: Calls preventDefault() on the click of a header.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_READONLY_DESCRIPTION_: The headers are text, not buttons: the items can not be opened or closed.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_STOP_DESCRIPTION_: Calls stopPropagation() on the click of a header, e.g. inside a clickable element.
_A_ACCORDION_PROPS_WITH_GAP_DESCRIPTION_: Space between the items, every item gets rounded corners.
_A_ACCORDION_SLOTS_ACCORDION_BUTTON_DESC: Content of every header button, before the label. Props: item, itemIndex, parentsIds, parentIndexes, id, currentId.
_A_ACCORDION_SLOTS_ACCORDION_CONTENT_DES: Content of every item instead of content. Props: item, itemIndex, parentsIds, parentIndexes, id, currentId.
_A_ACCORDION_SLOTS_SLOT_BUTTON_DESCRIPTI: Slot for the header button of one item, its name is in slotButton. Props as in accordionButton.
_A_ACCORDION_SLOTS_SLOT_CONTENT_DESCRIPT: Slot for the content of one item, its name is in slotContent. Props as in accordionContent.
_A_ACCORDION_EVENTS_TOGGLE_DESCRIPTION_: An item was opened or closed. Argument: { idsForOpen, currentId, parentsIds, isOpen, $event, item }.
_A_ACCORDION_EVENTS_UPDATE_MODEL_VALUE_D: Ids of the open items changed (v-model).
_A_ACCORDION_EXAMPLE_PAYMENT_CONTENT_: You can pay by invoice, credit card or PayPal.
_A_ACCORDION_EXAMPLE_RETURNS_CONTENT_: You can return the goods within 30 days.
_A_ACCORDION_EXAMPLE_ABROAD_CONTENT_: The costs depend on the country.
